summary.zh: agenthelm 顶层命令支持 --version，输出套件版本（读自发布内容的 index.json）；插件缓存里没有 index.json 时输出 agent-pack 插件版本并标注套件版本未知。
summary.en: The top-level agenthelm command now supports --version and prints the suite version (read from the release content's index.json); in plugin caches without index.json it prints the agent-pack plugin version and says the suite version is unknown.
